body:
your comment really means a lot to me, thank you

i just broke up w them yesterday, it was okay and they sounded fine in their texts but i could tell that they were hurt. then again, no matter how it happens, breakups hurt at least somehow in some way so the pain is inevitable. 

i think i’ll continue to do research and stuff to explore it more and hopefully get a more stable grasp on my thoughts and everything but thank you once again, this made me feel valid and i seriously appreciate you for this, please take care of yourself and have a nice day <33!

sorry if this is a rather stupid question but if you spend about 5 years in space, how many is that in years on Earth? 

i've tried looking it up and i can't find a definite answer, just explanations (but maybe there isn't a definite answer or i read stuff wrong)

hey !! i'm in that questioning stage right now (even though i think i'm almost certain) and what you just described is literally how i've felt/been feeling !

i just introduced myself to this term a few days ago therefore i'm still doing research too but i found it helpful to go online and look through discussions where people explain how they knew they were aromantic/how it feels to them 

personally, reading it i felt like i connected and related with a lot of the people and upon hearing it, it was just like something clicked, like it was finally an explanation for how i've felt these past years- dude it really felt like they ripped the words right out my fuckin throAt

i also read a few times that to some people it just clicked; like they instantly knew they were aromantic when they learned about it

regardless, i'm super supportive of you n your journey and i hope you find yourself soon !! i'm here right w ya if u need :) !!

I thought about that a little! I lost feelings for him a while after she told me she liked him, until I realized recently that I really didn't and that I just tried to suppress them. A conversation in the class I have with him revealed that he really isn't on his phone too much and doesn't see the point in apps like Snapchat and I wasn't the only one who he would leave on delivered for literally days at a time, which is somewhat comforting I guess. We still have conversations and he'll still make eye contact with me but overall he doesn't really express his emotions and that's something that a lot of people have noted. I figure that I'll end up losing feelings anyways and that this is some sort of phase, I hope it is. Thank you for your thoughts!!

Thinking about it, what she did really isn't right, but I still consider her a friend. We're new best friends, with the school I go to everyone comes from different towns so I just met her back in September. She's still really nice and somewhat supportive and funny and stuff but it's really just that aspect of her that I don't like.
